summary: Sentences read aloud in Belarusian by volunteer speakers for Google's FLEURS benchmark, which covers over a hundred languages with the same material. One row is one read sentence with its transcript. The same material is read in every language the benchmark covers, which makes results comparable across languages; it is prepared read speech, so it says little about how an engine copes with spontaneous conversation. The whole registered split is scored, uncapped.
notes: FLEURS Belarusian (be_by) test split: read speech with transcripts.
